name: Databases
description: Prometheus metrics from database exporters: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch

metrics.name: pg_up
metrics.notes: PostgreSQL connectivity check. 1=up, 0=down.

metrics.name: pg_stat_database_numbackends
metrics.notes: Number of active connections per database. Compare against max_connections for saturation.

metrics.name: pg_stat_database_xact_commit
metrics.notes: Total committed transactions per database.

metrics.name: pg_stat_database_xact_rollback
metrics.notes: Total rolled back transactions. High rollback rate indicates application errors.

metrics.name: pg_stat_database_blks_read
metrics.notes: Disk blocks read from storage. High values may indicate cache misses.

metrics.name: pg_stat_database_blks_hit
metrics.notes: Buffer cache hits. Cache hit ratio should be >99% for well-tuned databases.

metrics.name: pg_stat_database_tup_fetched
metrics.notes: Number of rows fetched by queries.

metrics.name: pg_stat_database_tup_inserted
metrics.notes: Number of rows inserted.

metrics.name: pg_stat_database_tup_updated
metrics.notes: Number of rows updated.

metrics.name: pg_stat_database_tup_deleted
metrics.notes: Number of rows deleted.

metrics.name: pg_stat_database_deadlocks
metrics.notes: Number of deadlocks detected. Any deadlocks warrant investigation.

metrics.name: pg_stat_database_temp_bytes
metrics.notes: Bytes written to temp files. High values indicate work_mem needs tuning.

metrics.name: pg_stat_activity_max_tx_duration
metrics.notes: Maximum duration of active transactions in seconds. Long-running transactions can cause bloat.
Count of connections by state (active, idle, idle in transaction).

metrics.name: pg_replication_lag
metrics.notes: Replication lag in seconds. Critical for HA setups.

metrics.name: pg_stat_replication_pg_wal_lsn_diff
metrics.notes: WAL position difference between primary and replica in bytes.

metrics.name: pg_locks_count
metrics.notes: Number of locks by mode. Watch for exclusive locks causing contention.

metrics.name: pg_stat_bgwriter_checkpoints_timed
metrics.notes: Scheduled checkpoints completed.

metrics.name: pg_stat_bgwriter_checkpoints_req
metrics.notes: Requested (forced) checkpoints. High ratio indicates checkpoint_segments too low.

metrics.name: pg_settings_max_connections
metrics.notes: Maximum allowed connections. Used to calculate connection saturation.

metrics.name: pg_database_size_bytes
metrics.notes: Database size in bytes. Track growth over time.

metrics.name: mysql_up
metrics.notes: MySQL connectivity check. 1=up, 0=down.

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_threads_connected
metrics.notes: Current number of open connections.

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_threads_running
metrics.notes: Number of threads actively executing queries.

metrics.name: mysql_global_variables_max_connections
metrics.notes: Maximum permitted simultaneous connections.

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_queries
metrics.notes: Total number of queries executed.

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_questions
metrics.notes: Number of statements executed by clients (excludes internal queries).

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_slow_queries
metrics.notes: Number of queries exceeding long_query_time threshold.
Command execution counts by type (select, insert, update, delete, etc.).

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_aborted_connects
metrics.notes: Failed connection attempts (authentication failures, timeouts).

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_aborted_clients
metrics.notes: Connections aborted due to client dying without closing properly.

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_innodb_buffer_pool_reads
metrics.notes: Disk reads when data not found in buffer pool.

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests
metrics.notes: Logical read requests from buffer pool. Used to calculate cache hit ratio.

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_innodb_buffer_pool_pages_total
metrics.notes: Total pages in InnoDB buffer pool.

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_innodb_buffer_pool_pages_free
metrics.notes: Free pages in buffer pool. Low values indicate memory pressure.

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_innodb_row_lock_waits
metrics.notes: Number of times operations waited for row locks.

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_innodb_row_lock_time
metrics.notes: Total time spent waiting for row locks (milliseconds).

metrics.name: mysql_global_status_innodb_deadlocks
metrics.notes: Number of InnoDB deadlocks detected.

metrics.name: mysql_slave_status_seconds_behind_master
metrics.notes: Replication lag in seconds. Critical for read replicas.

metrics.name: mysql_slave_status_slave_io_running
metrics.notes: Whether the I/O thread for reading the master's binary log is running.

metrics.name: mysql_slave_status_slave_sql_running
metrics.notes: Whether the SQL thread for executing events in the relay log is running.

metrics.name: mysql_info_schema_table_size
metrics.notes: Size of individual tables including data and indexes.

metrics.name: redis_up
metrics.notes: Redis connectivity check. 1=up, 0=down.

metrics.name: redis_connected_clients
metrics.notes: Number of client connections (excluding replicas).

metrics.name: redis_blocked_clients
metrics.notes: Number of clients blocked on BLPOP, BRPOP, or BLMOVE.

metrics.name: redis_memory_used_bytes
metrics.notes: Total memory allocated by Redis (including overhead).

metrics.name: redis_memory_max_bytes
metrics.notes: Maximum memory Redis can use. 0 means no limit.

metrics.name: redis_memory_used_rss_bytes
metrics.notes: Resident set size (actual memory from OS perspective).

metrics.name: redis_mem_fragmentation_ratio
metrics.notes: Memory fragmentation ratio. >1.5 indicates fragmentation issues.

metrics.name: redis_commands_processed_total
metrics.notes: Total commands processed by server.

metrics.name: redis_commands_duration_seconds_total
metrics.notes: Total time spent on commands by type.
Command calls by command type (get, set, hget, etc.).

metrics.name: redis_net_input_bytes_total
metrics.notes: Total bytes received by the server.

metrics.name: redis_net_output_bytes_total
metrics.notes: Total bytes sent by the server.

metrics.name: redis_keyspace_hits_total
metrics.notes: Number of successful key lookups. Used to calculate cache hit ratio.

metrics.name: redis_keyspace_misses_total
metrics.notes: Number of failed key lookups (cache misses).

metrics.name: redis_evicted_keys_total
metrics.notes: Keys evicted due to maxmemory limit. Any eviction indicates memory pressure.

metrics.name: redis_expired_keys_total
metrics.notes: Total keys expired. Normal operation for TTL-based caches.

metrics.name: redis_db_keys
metrics.notes: Number of keys per database.

metrics.name: redis_db_keys_expiring
metrics.notes: Number of keys with TTL set.

metrics.name: redis_connected_slaves
metrics.notes: Number of connected replicas.

metrics.name: redis_master_link_up
metrics.notes: Whether link to master is up (on replicas). 1=up, 0=down.

metrics.name: redis_master_repl_offset
metrics.notes: Replication offset on master. Compare with slave offset for lag.

metrics.name: redis_slowlog_length
metrics.notes: Number of entries in the slow log. Growing indicates slow queries.

metrics.name: redis_cluster_enabled
metrics.notes: Whether cluster mode is enabled.

metrics.name: redis_cluster_slots_ok
metrics.notes: Number of healthy cluster slots (16384 total).

metrics.name: redis_cluster_slots_fail
metrics.notes: Number of failed cluster slots. Any >0 indicates data unavailability.

metrics.name: mongodb_up
metrics.notes: MongoDB connectivity check. 1=up, 0=down.

metrics.name: mongodb_ss_connections
metrics.notes: Connection counts by type (current, available, totalCreated).
Operation counters by type (insert, query, update, delete, getmore, command).
Replication operation counters by type.

metrics.name: mongodb_ss_network_bytesIn
metrics.notes: Total bytes received by the server.

metrics.name: mongodb_ss_network_bytesOut
metrics.notes: Total bytes sent by the server.

metrics.name: mongodb_ss_network_numRequests
metrics.notes: Total number of requests received.

metrics.name: mongodb_ss_mem_resident
metrics.notes: Resident memory in MB.

metrics.name: mongodb_ss_mem_virtual
metrics.notes: Virtual memory in MB.

metrics.name: mongodb_ss_globalLock_currentQueue_total
metrics.notes: Total operations queued waiting for the lock.

metrics.name: mongodb_ss_globalLock_currentQueue_readers
metrics.notes: Read operations queued waiting for the lock.

metrics.name: mongodb_ss_globalLock_currentQueue_writers
metrics.notes: Write operations queued waiting for the lock.

metrics.name: mongodb_ss_globalLock_activeClients_total
metrics.notes: Total active client connections performing operations.
WiredTiger cache metrics (bytes in cache, maximum configured).

metrics.name: mongodb_ss_wt_cache_pages_evicted_by_application_threads
metrics.notes: Page evictions by app threads indicates cache pressure.

metrics.name: mongodb_ss_asserts_total
metrics.notes: Assertion counts by type (regular, warning, msg, user, rollovers).

metrics.name: mongodb_rs_members_state
metrics.notes: Replica set member state (1=PRIMARY, 2=SECONDARY, etc.).

metrics.name: mongodb_rs_members_optimeDate
metrics.notes: Timestamp of last oplog entry applied. Used to calculate replication lag.

metrics.name: mongodb_rs_members_health
metrics.notes: Health of replica set member. 1=healthy, 0=unhealthy.
Operation latencies by type (reads, writes, commands).
Collection storage statistics (size, count, avgObjSize).

metrics.name: elasticsearch_cluster_health_status
metrics.notes: Cluster health status. green=0, yellow=1, red=2. Red indicates data unavailability.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_cluster_health_number_of_nodes
metrics.notes: Number of nodes in the cluster.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_cluster_health_number_of_data_nodes
metrics.notes: Number of data nodes in the cluster.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_cluster_health_active_shards
metrics.notes: Number of active primary and replica shards.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_cluster_health_relocating_shards
metrics.notes: Number of shards being relocated.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_cluster_health_initializing_shards
metrics.notes: Number of shards being initialized.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_cluster_health_unassigned_shards
metrics.notes: Number of unassigned shards. Any >0 indicates allocation issues.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_indices_docs
metrics.notes: Total number of documents.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_indices_store_size_bytes
metrics.notes: Total size of all indices in bytes.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_indices_indexing_index_total
metrics.notes: Total number of indexing operations.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_indices_indexing_index_time_seconds_total
metrics.notes: Total time spent indexing.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_indices_search_query_total
metrics.notes: Total number of search queries.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_indices_search_query_time_seconds_total
metrics.notes: Total time spent on search queries.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_indices_search_fetch_total
metrics.notes: Total number of fetch operations.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_indices_search_fetch_time_seconds_total
metrics.notes: Total time spent fetching documents.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_jvm_memory_used_bytes
metrics.notes: JVM memory used (heap and non-heap areas).

metrics.name: elasticsearch_jvm_memory_max_bytes
metrics.notes: Maximum JVM memory configured.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_jvm_gc_collection_seconds_count
metrics.notes: Number of GC collection runs.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_jvm_gc_collection_seconds_sum
metrics.notes: Total time spent in GC. High old gen GC indicates memory pressure.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_os_cpu_percent
metrics.notes: CPU usage percentage.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_os_load1
metrics.notes: 1-minute load average.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_transport_rx_size_bytes_total
metrics.notes: Total bytes received via transport layer (inter-node communication).

metrics.name: elasticsearch_transport_tx_size_bytes_total
metrics.notes: Total bytes sent via transport layer.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_breakers_tripped
metrics.notes: Number of times circuit breaker tripped. Indicates queries too large for memory.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_breakers_estimated_size_bytes
metrics.notes: Estimated memory used by circuit breaker.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_thread_pool_queue_count
metrics.notes: Number of tasks queued in thread pool.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_thread_pool_rejected_count
metrics.notes: Number of tasks rejected by thread pool. Indicates overload.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_filesystem_data_available_bytes
metrics.notes: Available disk space on data path.

metrics.name: elasticsearch_filesystem_data_size_bytes
metrics.notes: Total disk space on data path.
